label: nikatakunai
title: 〜に難くない
meaning: not hard to ...(名詞＋にかたくない/　Vる＋にかたくない）
meaning_example: not hard to imagine it becoming a problem

notes.text:
in certain circumstances, it would be possible.

often used with imagine "it would not be hard to imagine this happening"
notes.html:
in certain circumstances, it would be possible.
often used with imagine "it would not be hard to imagine this happening"

examples.japanese: 彼の不安は想像にかたくない
examples.body_text:
彼の不安は想像にかたくない 

		Its not 
		hard to 
		imagine he is worried
examples.body_html:
彼の不安は想像にかたくない 
Its not hard to imagine he is worried

examples.japanese: 彼の喜びは、察するにかたくない。
examples.body_text:
彼の喜びは、察するにかたくない。 

		It's not hard to guess how happy he is.
examples.body_html:
彼の喜びは、察するにかたくない。 
It's not hard to guess how happy he is.

comments.text: This is very often used with 想像する and 察する.
comments.html: This is very often used with 想像する and 察する.

comments.text: 子供を亡くした親の悲しみは、察するにかたくない。
comments.html: 子供を亡くした親の悲しみは、察するにかたくない。
